title: Pure Codebreaker
summary: Codebreaker is a DARK Warrior Link-climbing engine centered around Codebreaker Zero Day, Virus Swordsman, and Virus Berserker. When Virus Swordsman is summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to, it pulls Zero Day from the Deck, climbs into Virus Berserker, and revives both Virus Swordsman and Zero Day to generate 4+ bodies and break the opponent's backrow.

allow.Sublimation Knight: Normal Summon starter that equips Squeaknight from the Deck to immediately produce 2 Warriors for Link plays.
allow.Squeaknight: Special Summons itself when equipped by Sublimation Knight.
allow.Fire Flint Lady: Level 1 Warrior extender that Special Summons itself to make a Link-2 with downward arrows for Virus Swordsman.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Codebreaker Zero Day, Sublimation Knight, or Fire Flint Lady.
allow.World Legacy Succession: Revives a Codebreaker monster directly to a zone a Link Monster points to, triggering Virus Swordsman or Virus Berserker.
allow.Living Fossil: Equip Spell that revives Codebreaker Zero Day from the GY for extra Link climbing.
allow.Divine Sword - Phoenix Blade: Warrior Equip Spell that banishes Warriors to recur itself.
allow.Cursed Bamboo Sword: Equip Spell that searches Golden Bamboo Sword when sent to the GY.
allow.Golden Bamboo Sword: Draws 2 cards alongside Cursed Bamboo Sword.
allow.Monster Reborn: Revives Codebreaker Virus Swordsman to a Link-pointed zone to re-trigger its effect.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior with two diagonal downward arrows pointing to zones for Virus Swordsman.
allow.Cross-Sheep: Link-2 with two downward diagonal arrows that triggers when a monster is summoned to its arrow.
allow.Accesscode Talker: Link-4 Cyberse boss climbed into via Codebreaker Virus Berserker.
allow.Rasterliger: Link-4 boss that tributes co-linked Codebreakers to destroy multiple cards on the field.
allow.Firewall Dragon Darkfluid: Link-5 Cyberse boss providing multiple monster effect negations and immense ATK gains.

main: Main Deck Codebreaker that reduces the ATK of all non-Codebreaker Link Monsters pointing to it by 1000 and blows itself up if that Link Monster is destroyed.
One-card starter that equips Squeaknight from the Deck to put 2 Warriors on the field.
Summons itself when equipped to Sublimation Knight.
Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Warrior to facilitate Link-2 plays.
Searches Sublimation Knight, Fire Flint Lady, or Codebreaker Zero Day.
Revives a Codebreaker monster directly to a zone a Link Monster points to, triggering Virus Swordsman or Virus Berserker.
Equip Spell that revives Codebreaker Zero Day from the GY for extra Link climbing.
Equip Spell that searches Golden Bamboo Sword.
Draws 2 cards alongside Cursed Bamboo Sword.
Revives Codebreaker Virus Swordsman to a co-linked zone to trigger its effect again.
extra: Link-2 Codebreaker that Special Summons Codebreaker Zero Day from hand, Deck, or GY when summoned into a co-linked state, and revives itself during the End Phase if destroyed.
Link-3 Codebreaker that revives up to 2 Codebreaker monsters from hand/GY when co-linked, and destroys opposing Spells/Traps up to the number of linked Codebreaker monsters.
Link-2 Warrior providing downward arrows for Virus Swordsman.
Link-2 provider of downward Link arrows.
Link-4 finisher made using Codebreaker Virus Berserker to pop cards and attack with 5300 ATK.
Link-4 boss that tributes the revived Codebreaker monsters to wipe the opponent's field.
Link-5: gains counters on summon for each monster card type in GY and detaches counters to negate monster effects.
